messages:
emma: Hi team — putting a concise manager-first-week playbook here for the incoming data PM (start Mon). Share any must-have additions or access steps we forget regularly.

ryan: Thanks Emma. Quick ask: can we confirm equipment and corp VPN by EOD Fri? Past hires hit delays when Okta groups weren’t created.

onboard-bot: Order RD-11722: MacBook Pro requested, tracking says delivery Fri 3pm PT. Okta group pending assignment. See https://redwood.internal/onboard/11722 for details.

tessa: I'll own the Okta/SSO piece. I'll submit the group create today and CC security. Also will pre-provision Google Drive folder and Confluence page.

emma: Great — manager playbook (short, copy/paste):
- Pre-week (before Day1): confirm laptop shipped, network access, email + calendar, GitHub org invite, Slack channels, and Confluence space. Assign a buddy.
- Day0 (setup): verify device receipt, VPN login, Okta MFA, Git access, JIRA/gcloud permissions.
- Day1 (orientation): 30m 1:1 welcome (manager), 30m team intro, 15m buddy intro, 30m product overview. Keep afternoon for environment setup.
- Days 2-5: schedule customer/context deep-dive, two stakeholder 1:1s (PM, eng lead), small hands-on task to ship (docs/bug/mini spec), and a baseline metrics review.
- Week-end: review a 30/60/90 draft with the new hire; set three measurable 30-day outcomes.

emma: Managers: reserve 20-30m each morning Day2-Day5 for quick check-ins to catch blockers.

ryan: Can you drop a 30/60/90 skeleton? I prefer it to be outcome-driven (measurable), not just a list of activities.

emma: Sure — paste below. This one is manager-first and ties to team KPIs.

emma: ```
30/60/90 skeleton (example for Data PM)
30 days (learn & deliver):
- Onboard: access to all systems and join core channels. (Success = all permissions confirmed by IT + buddy checklist completed)
- Customer context: read 3 top customer tickets and 2 postmortems. (Success = written summary shared with manager)
- Quick win: propose and ship a small change (doc, dashboard widget, or ticket triage). (Success = PR/patch or doc published)
60 days (own & orchestrate):
- Take lead on one small experiment/feature lifecycle from spec -> QA. (Success = spec + rollout plan + metrics defined)
- Build relationships: weekly stakeholder syncs established (eng, analytics, sales). (Success = meeting notes + owners)
90 days (impact & scale):
- Deliver a measurable improvement (eg. reduce query latency by X% or increase onboarding activation by Y). (Success = before/after metrics and retrospective)
- Roadmap contribution: draft a 3-month roadmap piece and present to team.
```

emma: Note: adapt the numeric targets with the hiring manager based on team baselines (don’t invent %s). Keep the new hire's draft visible to their manager and the skip-level for alignment.

claire: For transparency we usually add a one-line public milestone in Confluence: "First 30-day milestone: access + initial customer summary + one quick win." That helps other teams know what to expect.

ryan: Logistics question — where should managers publish the 30/60/90 draft? Confluence page or an internal Google doc?

tessa: Confluence is preferred (team space). If the hire wants to iterate privately first, fine — but move to Confluence after your manager review.

claire: IT heads-up: Some hires need special GCP billing roles later; don't request elevated roles until Day15 unless required. Saves security reviews.

emma: Good tip. Also, managers: pair the hire with a buddy who will run environment tests (local build, env vars, test tokens) on Day1 afternoon. Sample test commands:
- git clone git@github.com:redwood/repo.git; yarn install; yarn test
- run-dev.sh --env=local 

onboard-bot: GitHub invite sent. If the user reports repo access issue, open a ticket with #eng-oncall and include org:repo list.

emma: Last: hiring pipeline note — managers should not expect recruiter to keep pipeline open after offer accept; flag backfills within 2 weeks to hiring team. Add hiring status to your week-2 1:1 if you need recruiting support.

ryan: This is exactly what I needed. I'll copy this into a team checklist and tweak the measurable targets. Thanks Emma.

emma: Thanks all — ping here for any blockers. I'll post a quick Confluence template link once I adapt the 30/60/90 to PM specifics. :sparkles:
